page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.16xlarge is a compute-focused instance belonging to the Enhanced family, running on a KVM hypervisor. It is powered by 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.9 GHz. System memory is provisioned at 128.0 GB, establishing an exact 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 2.0 GB per vCPU.

Storage and networking configurations are structured around remote connectivity. The instance provisions no integrated local disk storage, necessitating network-attached block storage for operating system images and persistent data. High-bandwidth external operations are supported by a baseline network speed of 16 Gbps. No hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

By maintaining a compute-biased resource density without excess memory overhead, the ecs.c7se.16xlarge provides qualitative resource efficiency for parallel processing architectures. It is well configured for compute-bound tasks including distributed compiling, media encoding, scientific compute pipelines, and microservice backend systems.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.16xlarge is a compute-focused server instance from the Enhanced family, hosted on a KVM hypervisor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at 2.9 GHz, providing 64 vCPUs and 128.0 GB of memory. This configuration adheres to a 1:2 CPU-to-memory ratio, offering 2.0 GB of RAM per core to maximize processor density for execution-heavy workloads. Network throughput is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth profile. The server does not bundle local disk storage, requiring network storage attachments for persistent state, and excludes dedicated GPU accelerators as well as complimentary public IPv4 addressing. The resulting hardware balance makes the instance cost-effective for pure computational pipelines without surplus RAM expense, suiting large batch jobs, build farms, video transcoding, and scalable application serving.
